A little more about me

About Me

A bit about my research, the things I enjoy and what I do outside academia.

I have a PhD in Computing Science from the University of Glasgow, where I considered the structure and complexity of stable matching problems and developed new efficient algorithms for solving them.

I enjoy solving hard computational problems and exploring different approaches to them. My research is mainly in optimisation and algorithms, and I'm also interested in applied AI research.

Outside research

Community & Mentoring

I volunteer as a Programme Coordinator for CSA Africa and mentor Year 10–12 students with Generating Genius. I also enjoy reading science fiction and walking a lot.
